readme: Blue Dots voice agents — test cases
Test cases for every Blue Dots voice bot, in the same layout as the Purple Dots sheet. Prepared 5 Oct 2026 by Parth Bansal for the Operation Rozgar test cycle.
Tabs

Bots to Test: every bot, its language and direction, the number to dial or how to start it, and its Raya console link.
One tab per bot family after that. Each row is one test case.
Columns

Phase: the part of the call being tested, in the bot's own order.
Scenario: what is being tested.
What the tester should say: the exact words, in the bot's language. Text in [square brackets] says how to START the call (e.g. which inputs an outbound call needs).
Expected Response: what the bot must do, then 'Pass criteria' — what you should hear, and where relevant what the Raya console call log should show.
Actual Response, Verdict, Notes: for you to fill in.
Type

Smoke — run these first: the core cases that prove the bot works end to end.
Manual — full coverage.
Stress — robustness: silence, noise, talking over the bot, changing the topic, very long answers, several testers calling at once.
Priority

P0 — breaks the call or misleads the caller (wrong or invented job, says 'applied' when it did not, saves wrong data, skips consent).
P1 — a visible quality problem.
P2 — polish.
Verdict values
PASS · FAIL · PARTIAL · BLOCKED (could not set up the case) · NOT TESTED
Before you start — important

1. These are PRODUCTION bots on the real backend. An 'apply' creates a REAL job application, and every call creates or updates a REAL profile for the phone number that called.
2. Test only from your own or test phone numbers. Never use a job seeker's number.
3. A number becomes a 'returning caller' after its first call. Cases marked new / first-time caller need a number that has never called the bot before.
4. DKB creates or updates REAL job postings. Tell Parth which test postings to remove after testing.
Seeing what happened on a call
Raya console → the bot (links on the Bots to Test tab) → Calls. Each call has the transcript, the tool calls and the recording.
Reporting a failure
Fill in Actual Response + Verdict, and in Notes put the call time and the last 4 digits of the number you called from. That is enough for us to find the exact call.
Known issues (already being fixed — no need to log again)

1. Now and then (about 1 call in 15) the bot speaks a short English note aloud before the services offer, e.g. "Fetching services for the closing offer".
2. The PIN code / nearest-landmark questions are sometimes skipped for a returning caller.
3. Kannada: the Dharwad backend has no support-service providers listed yet, so the Kannada bot says no suitable service is available (Hindi has 8 providers).
4. The bots do not tell the caller the job's address; they say they don't have it.
5. On a bad line the bot says it will call back later, which does not happen on inbound calls.
Contact
Parth Bansal — parth@ekstepplus.org (reply on the Operation Rozgar thread).

bots.how_to_reach: Start from a campaign or the Raya console with the business and job details
bots.what_it_does: Employer / business-owner bot. Verifies an existing job posting or captures a new vacancy.

DKB.scenario: First turn is the audio check only
DKB.tester_says: [New-vacancy start: company_name = "New Star Garments"; job_role, num_vacancies, salary, location, qualification, work_experience, work_experience_years and job_id all = "Not Available"; city = your test city; phoneNumber = your 10-digit test number] Pick up and say "हैलो?" then, after the bot's first line, "हाँ, आ रही है।"
DKB.expected: Bot's first turn is only the audio check — Hindi "हैलो, मेरी आवाज़ आ रही है?" / Kannada "ಹಲೋ, ನನ್ನ ಧ್ವನಿ ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಾ ಇದೆಯಾ?" — then it waits for the reply before the opening question. Pass criteria: the first bot turn has no greeting, no introduction, no reason for calling, no business-name question and no recording disclosure; the opening question comes only after the tester's reply; the audio check is never asked again later in the call; no tool called in this stretch.

DKB.scenario: Opening names the business that was passed
DKB.tester_says: [New-vacancy start (company_name = "New Star Garments")] After the audio check: "हाँ, आ रही है।" then, to the opening question, "हाँ जी, मैं ही ओनर हूँ।"
DKB.expected: Bot asks to confirm the business by name — Hindi "हैलो! क्या आप न्यू स्टार गारमेंट्स से बोल रहे हैं?" / Kannada "ಹ್ಯಾಲೋ! ನೀವು ನ್ಯೂ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ ಗಾರ್ಮೆಂಟ್ಸ್ ನಿಂದ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀರಾ?" — waits for the yes, then moves on to Turn 2. Pass criteria: the business named is exactly the one passed, never a different or invented business; the pitch (free service, sixteen thousand job seekers, expiring posting) is NOT in the same turn as the identity question; the words "company name" / "not available" are never spoken; the city is not mentioned in the opening.

DKB.scenario: New-vacancy call: free-service pitch, then straight to the vacancy question
DKB.tester_says: [New-vacancy start: company_name = "New Star Garments"; job_role, num_vacancies, salary, location, qualification, work_experience, work_experience_years and job_id all = "Not Available"; city = your test city; phoneNumber = your 10-digit test number] "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ, मैं ओनर हूँ।" then, to the two-minute question, "हाँ, बोलिए।"
DKB.expected: Turn 2 is the new-vacancy line — "जी, मैं शहर प्रशासन की एम्प्लॉयमेंट पहल की तरफ से कॉल कर रही हूँ। … यह सर्विस बिल्कुल फ्री है। क्या आपके पास दो मिनट हैं?" / "ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ.. ನಾನು ನಗರ ಆಡಳಿತದ ಎಂಪ್ಲಾಯ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಉಪಕ್ರಮದ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ … ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹತ್ರ ಎರಡು ನಿಮಿಷ ಇದೆಯಾ?". After the yes: the AI/recording line, then directly the Step 3a question ending "…क्या आपके यहाँ अभी कोई vacancy है?" / "…ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹತ್ರ ಈಗ ಯಾವುದಾದರೂ vacancy ಇದೆಯಾ?". Pass criteria: no expiry line and no posting details; no freshness question; no explanation of the skip ("कोई posting नहीं मिली", "आपके पास कोई data नहीं है" or similar); "Not Available" is never spoken; "फ्री" / "ಫ್ರೀ" is clearly heard; no tool called.

Language testing.how: All snippets apart from the prompt instructions should be in the target language. No Hindi residue should be there
Language testing.pass_criteria: Zero characters outside the target language, with the single exception of the Goodbye token.

Language testing.how: Check the final word of every exit line, in every scenario, is exactly 'Goodbye' in Latin script, once, with nothing after it.
Language testing.pass_criteria: All exit lines end with the exact token. No translated or transliterated variant anywhere.

Language testing.how: Check the enum values, field names, tool names and JSON keys are unchanged English.
Language testing.pass_criteria: All enums and payload fields byte-identical to the source. Only spoken strings differ.

Language testing.how: For every line that is a question in the source, check it is marked the way the language marks a question.
Language testing.pass_criteria: Every source question is a question in the target, by that language's own marking.

Language testing.how: Check no spoken string contains numerals, abbreviations, clock conventions or currency symbols. All are written as words.
Language testing.pass_criteria: No digit or symbol in any spoken string.

Language testing.how: Check a table exists for this language, built from scratch rather than translated, giving the everyday word for each official or Sanskritised term.
Language testing.pass_criteria: Table exists, is language-specific, and every listed term has an everyday equivalent.

Language testing.how: Check a denylist of insulting words for this language exists and no denylisted word appears in any bot line.
Language testing.pass_criteria: Denylist exists. Zero denylisted words in bot speech.

Language testing.how: Check the rule for this language is written down rather than copied from Hindi, and no line needs the caller's gender before it is known.
Language testing.pass_criteria: A written per-language rule exists, and no line depends on an unknown caller gender.

Language testing.how: Check the translated consent disclosure contains every required element.
Language testing.pass_criteria: All elements present in the translated greeting, in both inbound and outbound.

Language testing.how: Place a test call and listen to every bot turn. Check the bot sounds warm and conversational, in the everyday spoken register of this language, not like a formal notice.
Language testing.pass_criteria: Every bot turn uses everyday spoken words. No turn sounds like a government circular or a word-for-word translation from Hindi.

Language testing.how: Listen to each question the bot asks during the call. Check it sounds like a question (rising tone or the language's question word) and the bot waits for the answer.
Language testing.pass_criteria: Every question is heard as a question, is asked once, and the bot pauses for the reply before moving on.

Language testing.how: Mention a disability or a personal difficulty during the call and listen to how the bot refers to it.
Language testing.pass_criteria: The bot uses respectful everyday words, never a denylisted or pitying term, and never makes the disability the topic of the call.

Language testing.how: Answer in your own everyday words, including local words and the English words common in this language.
Language testing.pass_criteria: The bot accepts the answer without asking you to repeat it in formal words, and repeats it back with the same meaning.

Language testing.how: Say a salary, a PIN code and a phone number aloud in the target language, then listen to the bot read them back.
Language testing.pass_criteria: Every number the bot speaks back is the number you said, spoken as words in the target language.

Language testing.how: Give a person's name, a place name and a company name, then listen to how the bot says them.
Language testing.pass_criteria: Each name is said as a name, not spelled out or read as English text. The console transcript shows each name in the target script.

Language testing.how: Run one call as a woman caller and one as a man. Listen to every line that addresses the caller, before and after the caller's gender is known.
Language testing.pass_criteria: No line uses a gendered form for the caller before the gender is known. The bot's own voice keeps one gender for the whole call.

Language testing.how: Say you lost your job, are short of money, or are upset, and listen to the bot's next line.
Language testing.pass_criteria: The bot acknowledges once in a calm, kind line, does not lecture or joke, and offers to carry on or end the call.

Language testing.how: Run the bot's Smoke scenarios in the target language from the first turn to Goodbye, and score each one PASS, FAIL or PARTIAL.
Language testing.pass_criteria: Every Smoke scenario passes in the target language, with the same tool calls in the console as the master-language run.
